column1: # name|signature|category|description|example
nk.tap|nk.tap(x, y)|touch|Tap once at screen coordinates|must(nk.tap(120, 450))
nk.hold|nk.hold(x, y, ms)|touch|Press and hold at coordinates|must(nk.hold(120, 450, 800))
nk.swipe|nk.swipe(x1, y1, x2, y2, ms)|touch|Swipe between two points|must(nk.swipe(120, 700, 120, 250, 450))
nk.sleep|nk.sleep(ms)|timing|Sleep without busy waiting|must(nk.sleep(500))
nk.openApp|nk.openApp(bundleId)|app|Bring an app to foreground|must(nk.openApp("com.example.app"))
nk.waitApp|nk.waitApp(bundleId, timeoutMs, intervalMs)|app|Wait until an app is foreground|must(nk.waitApp("com.example.app", 5000, 200))
nk.foreground|nk.foreground()|app|Read foreground bundle identifier|local app = must(nk.foreground())
nk.text|nk.text(text)|keyboard|Insert text through the native text API|must(nk.text("hello"))
nk.inputText|nk.inputText(text)|keyboard|Alias of nk.text|must(nk.inputText("hello"))
nk.showKeyboard|nk.showKeyboard()|keyboard|Show software keyboard|must(nk.showKeyboard())
nk.hideKeyboard|nk.hideKeyboard()|keyboard|Hide software keyboard|must(nk.hideKeyboard())
nk.moveCursor|nk.moveCursor(offset)|keyboard|Move text cursor by relative offset|must(nk.moveCursor(-1))
nk.delete|nk.delete(count)|keyboard|Delete characters near cursor|must(nk.delete(1))
nk.paste|nk.paste(text)|keyboard|Paste text through native paste path|must(nk.paste("hello"))
nk.getClipboard|nk.getClipboard()|clipboard|Read clipboard text|local text = must(nk.getClipboard())
nk.setClipboard|nk.setClipboard(text)|clipboard|Write clipboard text|must(nk.setClipboard("hello"))
nk.toast|nk.toast(kind, message, seconds)|ui|Show NKTouch toast|must(nk.toast("message", "Done", 2))
nk.hideToast|nk.hideToast()|ui|Hide current toast|must(nk.hideToast())
nk.screenshot|nk.screenshot(path)|vision|Capture JPEG screenshot|local path = must(nk.screenshot("/var/mobile/shot.jpg"))
nk.findImage|nk.findImage(path, maxTry, confidence, scale)|vision|Find an image template and return its rectangle|local hit = must(nk.findImage("/var/mobile/button.png", 2, 0.8, 0.8))
nk.waitImage|nk.waitImage(path, timeoutMs, intervalMs, confidence)|vision|Wait until an image template appears|local hit = must(nk.waitImage("/var/mobile/button.png", 5000, 250, 0.8))
nk.tapImage|nk.tapImage(path, timeoutMs, intervalMs, confidence)|vision|Wait for an image then tap its center|must(nk.tapImage("/var/mobile/button.png", 5000, 250, 0.8))
nk.getColor|nk.getColor(x, y)|vision|Read RGB color at one point|local c = must(nk.getColor(100, 100))
nk.findColor|nk.findColor(x, y, w, h, rmin, rmax, gmin, gmax, bmin, bmax, skip)|vision|Find a color range inside a rectangle|local hit = must(nk.findColor(0, 0, 750, 1334, 200, 255, 0, 80, 0, 80, 0))

nk.waitColor|nk.waitColor(x, y, w, h, rmin, rmax, gmin, gmax, bmin, bmax, timeoutMs, intervalMs, skip)|vision|Wait for a color range|local hit = must(nk.waitColor(0, 0, 750, 1334, 200, 255, 0, 80, 0, 80, 5000, 200, 0))

nk.tapColor|nk.tapColor(x, y, w, h, rmin, rmax, gmin, gmax, bmin, bmax, timeoutMs, intervalMs, skip)|vision|Wait for a color and tap its location|must(nk.tapColor(0, 0, 750, 1334, 200, 255, 0, 80, 0, 80, 5000, 200, 0))
nk.ocr|nk.ocr(x, y, w, h, languages)|vision|Run OCR explicitly on a rectangle|local text = must(nk.ocr(0, 0, 750, 300, "en-US"))

nk.waitText|nk.waitText(x, y, w, h, needle, timeoutMs, intervalMs, languages)|vision|Run explicit OCR checks until text appears|local text = must(nk.waitText(0, 0, 750, 300, "Continue", 5000, 300, "en-US"))
nk.screen|nk.screen()|device|Read screen dimensions|local screen = must(nk.screen())
nk.orientation|nk.orientation()|device|Read screen orientation|local orientation = must(nk.orientation())
nk.scale|nk.scale()|device|Read native screen scale|local scale = must(nk.scale())
nk.device|nk.device()|device|Read device information|local device = must(nk.device())
nk.battery|nk.battery()|device|Read battery information|local battery = must(nk.battery())
nk.runtime|nk.runtime()|device|Read runtime information|local runtime = must(nk.runtime())
nk.ping|nk.ping()|diagnostic|Ping the SpringBoard core|must(nk.ping())
nk.recordStart|nk.recordStart()|recorder|Start legacy HID recording task|must(nk.recordStart())
nk.recordStop|nk.recordStop()|recorder|Stop legacy HID recording task|must(nk.recordStop())
nk.status|nk.status(percent, message)|overlay|Update status overlay|nk.status(50, "Working")
nk.success|nk.success(message)|overlay|Show success state|nk.success("Done")
nk.warning|nk.warning(message)|overlay|Show warning state|nk.warning("Check input")
nk.error|nk.error(message)|overlay|Show error state|nk.error("Failed")
nk.hide|nk.hide()|overlay|Hide status overlay|nk.hide()
nk.log|nk.log(message)|overlay|Append runtime log|nk.log("step 1")
nk.heartbeat|nk.heartbeat()|overlay|Refresh runtime heartbeat|nk.heartbeat()
nk.classifyError|nk.classifyError(error)|diagnostic|Classify runtime error and transient state|local e = nk.classifyError(err)
nk.retryConfig|nk.retryConfig()|diagnostic|Read bounded read retry count|local retries = nk.retryConfig()
nk.coreVersion|nk.coreVersion()|diagnostic|Read embedded nkcore version|local version = nk.coreVersion()
nk.isDirect|nk.isDirect()|diagnostic|Check whether embedded direct nkcore is active|assert(nk.isDirect())
nk.benchmark|nk.benchmark(iterations)|diagnostic|Compare direct reads with CLI reads|local r = must(nk.benchmark(20))
nk.stress|nk.stress(iterations)|diagnostic|Run bounded read-only stress test|local r = must(nk.stress(100))
nk.installAutoTouchCompat|nk.installAutoTouchCompat()|compat|Install a small AutoTouch-compatible global API shim|nk.installAutoTouchCompat()
nk.http.request|nk.http.request(opts)|network|Explicit one-shot HTTP/HTTPS request; no automatic retry|local r,e,c=nk.http.request{method="GET",url="https://example.com",timeout_ms=5000}
nk.http.get|nk.http.get(url, opts)|network|HTTP GET with bounded response size|local r=assert(nk.http.get("https://example.com"))
nk.http.post|nk.http.post(url, bodyOrTable, opts)|network|HTTP POST string body or JSON table|local r=assert(nk.http.post("https://example.com/api",{ok=true},{decode_json=true}))
nk.http.download|nk.http.download(url, path, opts)|network|Stream response to a file without keeping it in Lua memory|assert(nk.http.download("https://example.com/file","/var/mobile/file.bin"))

nk.http.upload|nk.http.upload(url, path, opts)|network|Send a local file as the request body|assert(nk.http.upload("https://example.com/upload","/var/mobile/shot.jpg",{headers={["Content-Type"]="image/jpeg"}}))
nk.json.encode|nk.json.encode(value)|json|Encode Lua values as JSON with bounded nesting|local s=assert(nk.json.encode({ok=true}))
nk.json.decode|nk.json.decode(text)|json|Decode JSON with explicit json.null sentinel|local t=assert(nk.json.decode('{"ok":true}'))
nk.json.array|nk.json.array(table)|json|Tag an empty or explicit Lua table as JSON array|local s=assert(nk.json.encode({items=nk.json.array({})}))
nk.json.object|nk.json.object(table)|json|Tag a Lua table as JSON object|local s=assert(nk.json.encode(nk.json.object({})))
